goldfish.ui.refuse_take_1: It is bolted down, and I respect bolts.
goldfish.ui.refuse_take_2: It does not belong to me, and my list of such things is long enough already.
goldfish.ui.refuse_use_1: If I use that, nothing improves; it merely gets used.
goldfish.ui.refuse_use_2: There is no manual for that, and I always read the manual.
goldfish.ui.refuse_talk_1: It does not answer, which I count among its best qualities.
goldfish.ui.refuse_talk_2: I addressed it politely, and it fell politely silent.
goldfish.ui.refuse_item_1: Nothing connects these two things, not even a screw thread.
goldfish.ui.refuse_item_2: Together they would not make a solution, only two problems.
